microvilli.name: Microvilli (Brush Border)
microvilli.description: Sub-microscopic folding of the apical columnar plasma membrane that vastly multiplies the absorptive surface area.

columnar_epithelium.name: Single-Layer Columnar Epithelium
columnar_epithelium.description: Tall, single-cell layer providing a thin boundary for the rapid active and passive transport of digested nutrients.

goblet_cell.name: Goblet Cell
goblet_cell.description: Specialized glandular epithelial cell producing and secreting protective mucus that lubricates the intestine and protects against enzymatic auto-digestion.

lacteal.name: Central Lacteal (Lymphatic Vessel)
lacteal.description: Blind-ended central lymphatic capillary absorbing reconstituted chylomicrons (fatty acids, glycerol, and fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K).

capillary_network.name: Blood Capillary Network
capillary_network.description: Dense microvascular network absorbing water-soluble nutrients (glucose, galactose, amino acids, mineral ions) and transporting them directly to the hepatic portal vein.

crypt_of_lieberkuhn.name: Crypt of Lieberkühn (Intestinal Gland)
crypt_of_lieberkuhn.description: Invagination at the base of the villus containing rapidly dividing stem cells that regenerate the epithelial lining every 3-5 days.
